text:
ella (People Ops): @lucy Pierre in Paris flagged his first month pay 1/07 run. He says French social contributions were withheld AND US SS was taken. Can payroll confirm residency / treaty handling?

pierre (Engineer): Hi all  I accepted the offer as France-based and completed the new-hire form marking France as tax residence. My stub shows: 
```
Pay period: 07/01/2026 - 07/31/2026
Gross salary (EUR): 900.00
Gross USD equiv: $9,540.00
French social contrib: 250.00
Federal OASDI/Medicare: $744.00
Net: $6,546.00
```
I expected only French social and no US OASDI/Medicare due to A1/COC processing. I haven't received any request for the certificate.

ell a (People Ops): He mentioned he uploaded passport & proof of address but not the Certificate of Coverage. @lucy any record of COC requested/received?

lucy (Payroll): @payroll-bot check EmpID 54021 payrun 2026-07 and residency flags. Also check if COC request email was sent.

payroll-bot: Pulling payrun for EmpID 54021 period 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31... Found. payroll_profile.residency = FR. Social flows: French social contributions applied. Additionally, US FICA (OASDI/Medicare) was applied because employee is currently on US payroll jurisdiction by mistake (payroll_location = US). No Certificate of Coverage on file. No COC request outbound recorded. Creating ticket PAY-7824 for jurisdiction fix, off-cycle refund for FICA, and outbound COC request to employee.

pierre (Engineer): Ok thanks  I can get the COC from my previous employer in Paris but how long does the refund usually take? I need to budget for rent.

lucy (Payroll): For a payroll processing error we'll do an off-cycle refund for the incorrectly withheld FICA. ETA: 3 business days to issue the refund after ticket triage and documentation. We'll also send a formal COC request email and attach instructions for obtaining the A1/Certificate of Coverage. Once COC is on file we can retroactively correct FICA for the tax year and ensure future runs do not withhold.

ell a (People Ops): Pierre: please upload the COC or A1 to the HR portal and DM me once done. I'll follow up if you need help getting it from your prior employer. We'll cc you on the payroll ticket updates.

lucy (Payroll): One note: if the COC arrives later this quarter and covers prior months, we'll process retro adjustments that update YTD withholding and the payroll ledger. That will flow into year-end reporting. Ticket PAY-7824 will document W-2/W-2c impacts if needed.

pierre (Engineer): Thanks. Quick question: should I expect any tax forms from France for the employer-side social contributions? I just want to keep my records tidy.

lucy (Payroll): Employer social contributions are withheld/paid in France by local payroll provider; you'll receive a payslip showing employer & employee contributions. We'll include those totals in your expatriate packet. For US reporting: if we reverse FICA and keep FR contributions, US W-2 will not include FICA for those months once corrected.

h ris-bot: HRIS note: New-hire docs received 2026-06-28 09:14Z (passport, address). Country residency flag submitted but COC not provided.

ell a (People Ops): Great. I'll send Pierre a DM with step-by-step to obtain COC and the ticket link. @lucy please prioritise PAY-7824 as high since he needs a refund. :pray:

lucy (Payroll): Marking PAY-7824 high priority. Pierre, watch for an email from payroll@redwood.com with COC instructions.

pierre (Engineer): Received  thanks everyone for the quick responses. :thumbsup:
